endorsements.name: Xingyu Jin & Martijn Bogaard
endorsements.label: Tile-Based Deferred Rooting: When Your GPU Starts Rendering To Kernel Code Space!
endorsements.description: As GPUs assume increasingly intricate roles—from machine learning to advanced image processing and augmented reality—they are simultaneously becoming more appealing targets for attackers. Their exposed position to unprivileged applications and browser processes, allowing 0-click attacks, amplifies the need for rigorous security evaluation. In this presentation we will discuss an interesting vulnerability found on the Imagination DXT GPU. This adventurous exploit diverged from conventional kernel exploits as it leveraged undocumented behavior of the GPU hardware itself. Additionally, the Linux kernel mitigations turned out to be ineffective in preventing exploitation. Read more
